profile.name: Hamed Afzali
profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Technical Lead
profile.summary: 20+ years building banking, payment, and SaaS platforms, from national payment networks to multi-tenant cloud products. I make architecture decisions, lead the teams that build them, and still write code every day.
profile.contactIntro: Have an interesting architecture problem, a platform to modernize, or just want to talk engineering? Send a message or reach out directly.

careerHighlights.title: .NET 8 Modernization
careerHighlights.description: Helped make the call to move GMG's platform from .NET Framework to .NET 8 and leads the ongoing migration, including SQL CE to SQLite, while the product stays stable in production.

careerHighlights.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
careerHighlights.description: Built a Python MCP server with a RAG index of the GMG codebase, so LLM assistants can search and explain the code. Onboarding to the platform got much faster.

careerHighlights.title: 15,000+ Concurrent Users
careerHighlights.description: Architected a 15-node distributed SQL Server core banking platform serving 15,000 concurrent users with ACID-compliant transactional isolation at Postbank of Iran (PBI).

careerHighlights.title: National Payment Infrastructure
careerHighlights.description: Designed and delivered high-availability Java services for the Shetab national card network and the IBM MQ backbone for the Chakavak national cheque-clearing system.

careerHighlights.title: 400+ Branch Analytics Platform
careerHighlights.description: Sole architect and technical lead of a regulatory-grade BI and reporting platform consolidating real-time transaction data from 400+ branches, submitted to the Central Bank.

careerHighlights.title: Team Lead, 8 Engineers
careerHighlights.description: Led a cross-functional engineering team of 8 for 9 years at PBI, owning delivery, sprint planning, code quality, and technical mentorship across banking projects.

about: I've spent two decades building software that people and institutions depend on: a core banking platform serving 15,000 concurrent users, national card and cheque-clearing infrastructure, and a regulatory analytics platform used across 400+ branches and for Central Bank reporting.

For nine years I led an 8-person engineering team. I owned delivery, sprint planning, code quality, and mentoring, and I was the sole architect of the analytics platform, from design through production operations.

Today at GMG I take architecture-level ownership on a multi-tenant SaaS platform: leading the .NET 8 modernization, designing the security and identity architecture, shaping CI/CD, and building AI-assisted engineering tooling with MCP and RAG.

pillars.title: Platform architecture
pillars.text: Distributed, high-availability systems for banking, payments, and multi-tenant SaaS.

pillars.title: Technical leadership
pillars.text: Delivery planning, code quality, and mentoring engineers through complex work.

pillars.title: Modernization
pillars.text: Moving legacy platforms forward safely, like .NET Framework to .NET 8, without stopping production.

pillars.title: Security & identity
pillars.text: OAuth2, JWT, and fine-grained multi-tenant authorization.
